generators.carrier: unitary operators X^a Z^b on C^6

relations.statement: Weyl operators W(u), W(v) commute iff symplectic_form(u,v)=0 mod 6
relations.hypotheses: dimension 6, Z_6 x Z_6 displacement labels

lemmas.statement: Every partition of the 35 non-identity classes of Z6xZ6 into maximal commuting classes is impossible, and Weyl-Heisenberg constructions give at most three MUBs in C^6

near_misses.claim: Z_6 behaves like Z_p, where p+1 maximal commuting classes partition the nonidentity displacements
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: 6 is composite and not a prime power, so the Chinese remainder splitting Z2 x Z3 gives subgroups that are not cyclic lines of the required form

open_obligations: exact enumeration of maximal commuting subgroups of Z6xZ6 under the symplectic form
proof that no partition of the 35 nonidentity classes exists
proof that at most three MUBs arise from Weyl constructions
clarify that this does not bound arbitrary MUBs in C^6
